name: biz.notaryon/calculators
title: Israeli Real Estate and Legal Calculators
description: Israeli purchase and appreciation tax, court deadlines, limitation, notary fees, inheritance.

tools.name: purchase_tax
tools.description: Israeli purchase tax (mas rechisha) on buying real estate: apartment, land, business property or farm. Uses the brackets in force on the transaction date (Land Taxation Law s.9 and the Tax Authority instructions). Runs the official calculator of dira-law.co.il.

value.description: Value of the property / consideration in ILS (from a developer: including VAT)

asset.description: res = residential apartment (default), land = land/plot, biz = business property, farm = agricultural farm

deal.description: sale = purchase for consideration (default), gift = transfer without consideration from a relative, spouse = transfer of a residential apartment without consideration to a spouse living in it

buyer.description: For residential: single = only apartment (default), additional = additional apartment, oleh = new immigrant, foreign = foreign resident, disabled = disabled person / victim of hostilities / bereaved family

replacement_apartment.description: Single apartment bought as a replacement while still owning the previous one (to be sold within the statutory period)

tools.name: capital_gains_tax
tools.description: Israeli land appreciation tax (mas shevach) on selling real estate: real gain, linear tax calculation, deductions indexed to the CPI, and the residential exemptions (single apartment s.49B(2), inherited apartment s.49B(5), one-time exemption for two apartments s.49H). Runs the official calculator of dira-law.co.il.

kind.description: dwell = residential apartment (default), other = other real estate right, igud = right in a real estate association

sale_value.description: Sale value of the whole property, ILS

purchase_cost.description: Purchase value of the whole property, ILS

qualified_dwelling.description: The apartment served mainly for residence during 4/5 of the gain period or the 4 years before the sale (default true for dwell)

deductions.description: Deductible expenses (purchase tax, lawyer fees, brokerage, improvements...)

type.description: exp = expense (fees, brokerage, purchase tax), impr = improvement (date = completion), tax = property tax, int = real interest, after = expense paid after the sale

sellers.description: Sellers (default: one Israeli resident individual with 100%)

exemption.description: none, b2 = single apartment s.49B(2), b5 = inherited apartment s.49B(5), h = one-time two-apartment exemption s.49H

exemption_conditions_met.description: The seller declares that all the statutory conditions of the requested exemption are met (default true)

tools.name: court_deadline
tools.description: Last day for filing a pleading, motion or appeal in Israeli civil courts under the Civil Procedure Regulations 2018: counts from service, excludes court recess (Sukkot, Passover, summer), moves a last day falling on Friday, Saturday or a holiday, and applies reg. 161 for late electronic service. Runs the official deadlines calculator of il-law.co.il.

act.description: defense = statement of defence; defmed = defence in a medical malpractice claim; deffast = defence in expedited procedure; defevict = defence in an eviction claim; reply = reply to defence; third = third-party notice; thirdfast = third-party notice in expedited procedure; amend = amended pleading; motion = response to a motion; reqlist = response to request for documents/interrogatories; setaside = motion to set aside a judgment; appeal = appeal; crossapp = cross-appeal; appresp = response/reply in appeal; medcounter = counter expert opinion (medical)

service_method.description: elec = electronic (Net Hamishpat/e-mail), mail = registered mail, personal = personal delivery, fax, court = given in court

service_time.description: HH:MM, for electronic or fax service (optional)

tools.name: interest_and_linkage
tools.description: Linkage differentials and interest on a judgment debt under the Israeli Adjudication of Interest and Linkage Law (including the 2026 amendment rules): CPI linkage and statutory interest per period. Runs the official calculator of il-law.co.il.

decision_date.description: Date of the judgment/decision that set the debt, YYYY-MM-DD

kind.description: award = principal (default), costs = costs and fees

track.description: What was awarded: shekel = nominal amount with statutory interest and linkage (default), link = linkage only, linkint = linkage and interest

tools.name: construction_index_linkage
tools.description: Linkage of payments to a developer to the Israeli construction inputs index (madad tsumot habniya) under the Sale (Apartments) Law amendment: only 50% of each payment is linked, the cap at the contractual delivery date. Runs the official calculator of dira-law.co.il.

price.description: Apartment price in the contract, ILS

linked_share_percent.description: Linked share of each payment under the contract, % (0-50, default 50)

tools.name: apartment_purchase_costs
tools.description: Estimated total additional costs of buying an apartment in Israel: purchase tax, lawyer fees, brokerage, registration fees, appraiser, inspector and more. Runs the official calculator of dira-law.co.il.

type.description: used = second-hand (default), dev = from a developer

buyer.description: For purchase tax: single = only apartment (default), additional = additional apartment

lawyer_percent.description: Lawyer fee, % of price before VAT

tools.name: delivery_delay_compensation
tools.description: Statutory compensation for late delivery of a new apartment by a developer under section 5A of the Israeli Sale (Apartments) Law: grace period and multipliers of the rent of a similar apartment. Runs the official calculator of dira-law.co.il.

monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent of a similar apartment, ILS

contract_monthly_compensation.description: Monthly compensation set in the contract, ILS (optional)

buyer_caused_or_force_majeure.description: The delay was caused solely by the buyer, or by circumstances under s.18(a) of the Contracts (Remedies) Law

tools.name: combination_vs_cash
tools.description: Compares selling land for cash with a combination deal (land for apartments) with a developer, in present-value terms. Runs the official calculator of dira-law.co.il.

purchase_cost.description: Cost of acquiring the property, ILS

cash_costs.description: Costs in the cash sale, ILS

cash_tax.description: Land appreciation tax in the cash sale, ILS

unit_value.description: Estimated value of each apartment at delivery, ILS

rent.description: Rent from the developer during construction, ILS per month

cash_from_developer.description: Cash payment from the developer, ILS

land_share_sold.description: Share of the land sold to the developer, %

combo_costs.description: Costs in the combination deal, ILS

combo_tax.description: Tax in the combination deal, ILS

tools.name: warranty_periods
tools.description: Inspection (bedek) and warranty periods for defects in a new apartment under the Israeli Sale (Apartments) Law, by type of defect, from the delivery date. Runs the official calculator of il-law.co.il.

contract_date.description: Contract signing date (determines which version of the law applies), YYYY-MM-DD

building_completed.description: Date the construction of the building was completed (recommended), YYYY-MM-DD

discovery_date.description: Date the defect was discovered (optional), YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: court_fees
tools.description: Israeli court filing fees (agra) for a civil claim by type of proceeding, court and claim amount, under the Courts Regulations (Fees). Runs the official calculator of il-law.co.il.

type.description: money = monetary claim; reg3 = claim under reg. 3; other = non-monetary; body = bodily injury; sex = sexual offence damages; amend = amended claim; rent = eviction; insolv = insolvency; cc = counterclaim/third party; small = small claims; fam = family court; exec = execution office; appeal = appeal

filed.description: Filing date (only together with second_half_paid, for linkage of the second half), YYYY-MM-DD

second_half_paid.description: Date the second half of the fee was paid, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: notary_fee
tools.description: Israeli notary fees: the maximum fee a notary may charge under the Notaries Regulations (Service Fees), for signature certification, true copy, translation certification, will, affidavit, prenuptial agreement, life certificate, revocation of a power of attorney, noting of a bill, or any other act; with the after-hours surcharge, service outside the office and VAT. Uses the fee table of the official calculator of notaryon.biz (2026 amounts).

service.description: sig = signature certification; copy = certified true copy; trans = certification of a translation; will = will made before a notary; aff = affidavit/declaration; mamon = certification of a prenuptial (property) agreement; alive = life certificate; revoke = revocation of a power of attorney; bill = noting/protest of a negotiable instrument; other = an act with no fee set in the regulations

on_behalf.description: sig: how many of them sign on behalf of another (company or power of attorney)

copies.description: sig: copies certified at the same time; revoke: certified copies bearing the revocation note

extra_certificates.description: copy/trans/will/aff/mamon: additional certificates of the same document at the same time

words.description: trans: number of words in the translation; for sig/will/aff/mamon with notary_translates: words of the translation made by the notary

notary_translates.description: sig/will/aff/mamon: the notary also translates the document (adds half the translation fee)

persons.description: will: number of testators; aff: number of deponents (default 1)

amount.description: bill: amount of the instrument, ILS

after_hours.description: Service outside regular hours (50% surcharge; not for service outside the office)

travel_costs.description: Travel expenses, ILS (not set by the regulations)

other_language.description: The document is drawn up in a language other than Hebrew, Arabic or English

tools.name: intestate_inheritance
tools.description: Israeli intestate succession (no will): who inherits and each heir's share under the Succession Law 1965, ss. 10-14 and 55 (spouse or cohabitant, children and grandchildren, parents, full and half siblings, grandparents, uncles and cousins), per stirpes, following the Supreme Court rulings BAM 785-03-26 (11.10.2026, half-siblings) and HCJ 5132/22 (2024). Flags questions not settled by binding Supreme Court authority.

spouse.description: Surviving spouse: none, married spouse, or cohabiting partner meeting s.55 (default none)

years_together.description: Years of marriage or life together (relevant to the apartment rule in s.11(a)(2))

lived_in_estate_apartment.description: The spouse lived with the deceased in an apartment that is part of the estate

children_alive.description: If predeceased: number of his/her living children

siblings.description: Brothers and sisters of the deceased

relation.description: Shared parents: both, father only, mother only (default both)

children_alive.description: If predeceased: number of his/her living children

uncles_aunts.description: Siblings of the deceased's parents (relevant only with no children, parents or siblings)

side.description: Sibling of the father or of the mother

children_alive.description: If predeceased: number of his/her living children (cousins)

parent_share_rule.description: Disputed case of a spouse plus one living parent where the other parent predeceased leaving children: surviving-parent (accepted in case law, default) or substitutes (Shilo)

tools.name: limitation_period
tools.description: Israeli limitation (prescription) period for a civil claim: when the period ends, by type of claim (contract, tort, construction defects, insurance, defective product, land, enforcement of a judgment), with discovery, minority, admission, inheritance and periods when the clock stopped, under the Prescription Law 1958 and related laws. Runs the official calculator of il-law.co.il.

type.description: contract = contract, debt or restitution; tort = personal injury, negligence or property damage; defects = construction defects in a new apartment; insurance = claim against an insurer; product = defective product that caused bodily injury; land = right in land; judgment = opening an execution file to enforce a judgment

cause_date.description: Date the cause of action arose (defects: delivery date to the first buyer; judgment: date of the judgment or last enforcement action), YYYY-MM-DD

discovery_date.description: Date the facts or damage became known, if later (defects: date the defect was discovered), YYYY-MM-DD

insurance_type.description: insurance: gen = property, home, car or other; life = life, illness and hospitalisation; dis = disability; liab = liability insurance

policy_date.description: insurance (life): date the insurance contract was made or renewed, YYYY-MM-DD

land_settled.description: land: set = settled and registered land; unset = not settled; unk = unknown

product_year.description: product: year the product left the manufacturer's control

defect_category.description: defects: 0 damp/waterproofing, 1 piping, 2 flooring/cladding, 3 windows/doors/aluminium, 4 machinery/boilers, 5 yard works, 6 thermal insulation, 7 cracks over 1.5 mm in non-load-bearing elements, 8 external cladding, 9 other (plaster, paint, electrical), 10 stability/load-bearing, 11 non-conformity with specification or standard

defect_visible.description: defects: open = visible on reasonable inspection at delivery; hid = hidden

agreed_months.description: contract/land: limitation period in months set in a separate written agreement, if any

admission_date.description: Date the defendant admitted the right or paid part of it, YYYY-MM-DD

birth_date.description: Claimant's date of birth, if a minor when the cause arose, YYYY-MM-DD

inheritance_date.description: If the right passed by inheritance: date of death, YYYY-MM-DD

reason.description: s7 = fraud, threats or force by the defendant; s11 = claimant unable to manage affairs without a guardian; s12 = guardian and ward; s13 = the parties were married; s15 = an earlier claim was dismissed without barring a new claim; ins = stay in insolvency proceedings

tools.name: construction_defects_check
tools.description: Construction defects check for an apartment in Israel: for each defect, whether it is still within the inspection (bedek) or warranty period under the Sale (Apartments) Law, notice deadlines, the contractor's right to repair, limitation, and which documents to gather. Runs the official defects diagnoser of il-law.co.il.

bought_from.description: dev = from the contractor/developer; sub = from the first buyer of a new apartment; old = second-hand apartment; self = self-build with a building contractor

self_build_clause.description: self: the contract with the contractor applies the inspection and warranty periods of the Sale Law

location.description: Where the defects are: apt = in the apartment; common = common property; both

building_completed.description: Date construction of the building was completed (optional), YYYY-MM-DD

delivery_date.description: Date the apartment was delivered to the first buyer, YYYY-MM-DD

category.description: 0 damp/waterproofing, 1 piping, 2 flooring/cladding, 3 windows/doors/aluminium, 4 machinery/boilers, 5 yard works, 6 thermal insulation, 7 cracks over 1.5 mm in non-load-bearing elements, 8 external cladding, 9 other (plaster, paint, electrical), 10 stability/load-bearing, 11 non-conformity with specification or standard

visible.description: Could it be found on reasonable inspection at delivery: hidden = no; open = yes; unk = not sure

notified.description: Date the contractor was notified in writing, YYYY-MM-DD

contractor_response.description: none = not approached yet; wait = approached, awaiting repair; refused = refused or did not repair; again = repaired and the defect recurred; urgent = urgent defect not repaired; done = repaired

documents.description: Documents already held: sale contract and specification, delivery protocol, maintenance instructions, dated photos, notices and replies, repair records, engineer's opinion

tools.name: apartment_transfer_to_relative
tools.description: Transferring an apartment to a relative in Israel: compares a gift, a sale and inheritance, with purchase tax (one third or one quarter for relatives without consideration), land appreciation tax, the 4-year cooling period (s.49B(5) and 49H) and the points to check. Runs the official calculator of dira-law.co.il.

value.description: Market value of the apartment, ILS

relation.description: Recipient in relation to the giver: desc = child or grandchild; dspouse = spouse of a child or grandchild; spouselive = spouse living with the giver; spouse = spouse not living together; parent; gparent = grandparent; step = child or grandchild of the spouse; sibpar = sibling where the parents gave; sib = sibling; other

recipient_status.description: single = it will be the recipient's only apartment; add = the recipient already owns an apartment

sale_price.description: Sale price, if different from the value, ILS

sale_exempt.description: If sold: is the sale exempt from land appreciation tax (sole residential apartment)

appreciation_tax.description: If the sale is taxable: estimated land appreciation tax, ILS

recipient_lives_there.description: The recipient will live in the apartment permanently

recipient_birth_date.description: Recipient's date of birth, if under 18, YYYY-MM-DD

giver_single_apartment.description: Does the giver own only one residential apartment

tools.name: tama38_pinui_binui_offer
tools.description: Checks a developer's offer in TAMA 38 (strengthening or demolition and reconstruction) or pinui-binui (urban renewal) in Israel: value of the apartment today vs after the project in present value, break-even price per sqm against selling today, the effect of 12 and 24 months of delay, cash payment from the developer, signature majority, and warning signs in the offer (guarantees, permit, deadlines, specification, separate lawyer). Runs the official calculator of dira-law.co.il.

track.description: 2 = TAMA 38/2 demolition and reconstruction (default); 1 = TAMA 38/1 strengthening and additions; p = pinui-binui

value.description: Value of the apartment today, ILS

area.description: Area of the apartment today, sqm

new_area.description: Area of the apartment after the project, sqm

price_per_sqm.description: Estimated price per sqm of a new apartment in the area, ILS

extras_value.description: Value of new parking and storage, ILS

rent.description: Rent the developer pays per month, ILS

own_rent.description: Rent for a suitable apartment per month, ILS

fee_increase.description: Expected increase in maintenance fees per month, ILS

apartments.description: Number of apartments in the building (pinui-binui: in the whole complex)

signed.description: How many owners have signed so far

cash.description: Cash payment from the developer, ILS

offer.description: What the offer says. Each answer: y = yes, n = no, u = unknown (default)

tools.name: apostille_country_check
tools.description: Is a country (or territory) party to the Hague Apostille Convention in relation to Israel? Returns whether an Israeli document needs only an apostille or consular legalisation, based on the HCCH status table, including objections and territorial extensions.

country.description: Country name in English or Hebrew
